I, Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the land described below is neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of below mentioned land depicted in the AdvanceTracing No. CO/MHR/2016/553 and dated 17.06.2017, preparedby the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village of Rukmale (withinthe Maharagama Municipal Council) in the Minor Division ofPallepattuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Maharagamain Colombo District in Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Welihenpitalanda Watta – Extent: 0.0199 HectareNorth: Welihenpitalanda Watta claimed by W. A. D. Sunil andothers; East: The land which land name and claimant cannot befound; South: The land which land name and claimant cannot befound and Thummodara Kumbura claimant cannot be found; West:Thummodara Kumbura claimant cannot be found.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
